title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
text: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference. Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.
